Use case: stylized-concept / style-transfer. Generate ONE full-body front-view SD pixel-art concept of the SAME young adult male blond dual-sword warrior, standing still with both soles planted. Genuine clean transparent background. No labels or guide marks.
INPUT ROLES: Image1 is the established warrior IDENTITY and pixel-art material reference; Image2 is BODY PROPORTIONS ONLY, its red marks must never appear; Image3 is small-character visual legibility and design-language study ONLY, do not copy any character or background; Image4 is grasp/anatomy and weapon-axis guidance ONLY, never copy its character/armor/sword design.
REMODEL the anatomy through new drawing, not stretching: aim about 3.3 hair-inclusive heads tall like image2, chin at 30% body height, shoulders34%, crotch65%, knees82%, soles100%. Compact upper torso, tidy arms reaching upper thigh, relatively longer clean lower legs. Reduce the original's bulky balloon trousers and massive boot volumes. Head width near unarmored shoulder width. Keep young male appearance, brown eyes, spiky layered golden-blond hair. Render crisp deliberate pixel clusters, dark colored contour, restrained broad cel shades, bright silver facet highlights, cobalt blue fabric and warm brown leather, matching image1's established pixel finish rather than 3D or smooth illustration.
IDENTITY INVARIANTS: blue scarf and lowered short hood, silver chest/shoulder/forearm armor and gauntlets, blue waist cloth, brown belts/pouches/trousers. Anatomical RIGHT shoulder (viewer LEFT) bears crescent emblem. Anatomical RIGHT leg (viewer LEFT) has silver plated shin and boot; anatomical LEFT leg (viewer RIGHT) is blue cloth wrapped boot with small metal protectors. No long cape.
WEAPONS: exactly two: anatomical RIGHT hand/viewer LEFT holds the LONGSWORD, with blue diagonal blade accents, wing-shaped silver guard and large ring knuckle guard. Anatomical LEFT hand/viewer RIGHT holds short angular DAGGER with small guard. Preserve their recognizable distinct original designs. Each gauntleted hand wraps its actual grip; opposing thumb and curled fingers, connected forearm/wrist/palm, coherent single straight weapon axis. Lowered relaxed front idle pose, long sword angles down across foreground toward opposite foot as grip reference; keep its blue blade and both boots readable with clear separation, dagger down at the other side. No floating, extra or fused fingers, no duplicated weapons.
FRAMING: square canvas with generous clean transparent margin, hair top near20% canvas and soles94%, whole body about74% canvas height; equipment fits fully inside. Do not enlarge a variant because its armor is broader. No floor shadow, grid, scene, text, watermarks, red/blue guidelines.
VARIANT1 — faithful inheritance. Preserve image1's gentle brown-eye expression, small closed smile and original recognizable layered blond fringe most closely. Reorganize armor into clean two or three silver planes and layered compact pauldrons, moderate shoulder width; tidy brown waist belts and pouch, less ballooned trousers. Balanced upright stance. This is the baseline proportional remodel, not a different person.

Hair-top to chin must occupy 30 to 31 percent of the hair-top to sole height (not 25 percent). The chin is at body30%, shoulders34%, belt55%, crotch65%, knee82%. These landmarks are shared by all four concept options; variant3 changes only width, variant2 slenderness, not head/body ratio. The finished front sprite should feel like image2's short youthful game avatar, not a 4-head-tall slim adolescent. Keep head centered and whole body about74% canvas high with 20% empty top margin.
